nodes.label: Captio – Historial de clientes (Spanish UI screenshot)
nodes.description: UI screenshot of the Captio web application in Spanish (ES locale). Shows the 'Historial de clientes' (Client History) page with a left sidebar navigation containing: Nuevo Cliente, Clientes (active/highlighted), Notas de caso, Archivos, a language switcher (ES selected vs EN), and Cerrar sesión. The top-right shows a logged-in user 'toledolaw' with an online indicator. The main content area displays four stat cards: 2 TOTAL, 0 ACEPTADOS, 0 EN REVISIÓN, 1 NUEVOS. Below is a search bar ('Buscar por nombre o caso...') with a status filter dropdown ('Todos los estados'). Two client cards are visible: #4 Distribuidora Nexo Comercial S.A.P.I. de C.V. (status: Nuevo, category: Negocios/contrato, date: 04 jun 2026, 1 evento) and #1 Toledo Realtors (status: Invitado, date: 04 jun 2026, 1 evento). A floating help button (?) is in the bottom-right corner. The design uses a light gray/white theme with blue accents for active states.
